company.name: Talvera Sensorik GmbH
company.summary: Invented example. Maker of a skin patch that tracks glucose during endurance sport. Looking for a clinical study partner, sensor research and a site for a small team.

title: Bern for wearable glucose sensing
intro: The groups look forward to your visit.

cards.name: Sensors and signal processing
cards.text: A Bern research group combines skin sensors and signal processing for metabolic monitoring, the core of your patch [1].

sources.quote: The group develops skin worn sensors and signal processing methods for continuous metabolic monitoring.
sources.title: Metabolic Sensing Group

cards.name: Clinical study on sport
cards.text: A Bern clinical centre already runs a study on glucose levels during endurance sport.

sources.quote: The study follows glucose levels in adults with type 1 diabetes during endurance training.
sources.title: Glucose and endurance study

cards.name: Prof. Erika Muster
cards.unit: Metabolic Sensing Group, Institute for Biomedical Engineering
cards.text: The group builds skin worn sensors and the algorithms that turn their signals into glucose estimates. Its current project tests a patch during physical activity.
cards.notes: Internal: the group head is on leave in November. Ask before proposing a date.

sources.quote: The group develops skin worn sensors and signal processing methods for continuous metabolic monitoring.
sources.title: Metabolic Sensing Group

sources.quote: The project evaluates a wearable glucose patch during physical activity in a controlled setting.
sources.title: Wearable patch during activity

cards.name: Forschungsabteilung für Sensorgestützte Stoffwechselüberwachung und Bewegungsphysiologie
cards.text: Dr. Beispiel has agreed to show you the movement lab and will meet your team in November.

sources.quote: Our movement lab combines motion capture with gas exchange analysis to study metabolism during exercise.
sources.title: Metabolism and movement

cards.name: Clinical Trial Unit
cards.text: The clinical trial unit helps companies plan and run studies, including approvals and data management.
